name: Volunteer waiver
summary: Linked from the volunteer sign-up page: the volunteer enters the event code, their phone and an emergency contact, then signs the waiver on the form's Signature page in the same session.

welcome.title: Volunteer waiver
welcome.text: Thank you for volunteering. Fill in a few details, then sign the waiver on the last page.

thankYou.title: Thank you
thankYou.text: Your signed waiver is emailed to you. See you at the event.

descriptions.event_code: The code on the sign-up page for your event, e.g. PARK-CLEANUP-1114
